For explicit v_i^+/-=s e_{i+1}+/-c e_i, c>2s, support-hyperplane equations exclude unselected opposite vertices and guarantee exact cross-polytope combinatorics in all dimensions. Exact-rational independent facet checks for n=2..5 and profile samples passed, supplemental to analytic proof.

originality.rationale: Horváth–Lángi 2014 Corollary 3 proves the regular cross-polytope is the volume maximizer, while Medgyes 2026 treats eight-vertex 4-polytopes. Neither determines an exact nonlinear deficit as a function of matching Procrustes distance or non-antipodal equality family. Nuclear-norm Procrustes and AM-GM are recognized as standard ingredients, not separately new; the constrained geometric equality and all-dimensional attainability yield the substantive refinement. Best-of-knowledge, not exhaustive.
